description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to interact with a remote network share using Server Message Block (SMB). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user. Windows admin shares are a feature of the Windows operating system that allow administrators to remotely access a disk volume on a network system. These are hidden network shares created by default that allow administrative users to access the root directory of every volume.
artifacts: SMB connections to ADMIN$, C$, IPC$ shares
SMB protocol negotiation and session setup
SMB tree connect requests to administrative shares
RPC over SMB (TCP/445) for remote command execution
WMI over SMB for remote command execution
authentication attempts with domain or local credentials
failed access attempts due to insufficient privileges

pcaps.name: Internal SMB PsExec - successful (impacket)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated lateral movement using psexec.py (impacket) via SMB admin shares showing successful remote command execution on target host.

pcaps.name: Internal SMB PsExec - failed no privileges (impacket)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated PsExec attempt using psexec.py (impacket) via SMB admin shares showing failed access due to insufficient privileges (user authenticated but lacks admin rights on target).

pcaps.name: Internal SMB PsExec - failed bad password (impacket)
pcaps.description: Internal unauthenticated PsExec attempt using psexec.py (impacket) via SMB admin shares showing failed authentication due to incorrect credentials.

pcaps.name: Internal SMB WMIExec - successful (impacket)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated lateral movement using wmiexec.py (impacket) via SMB showing successful remote command execution through WMI on target host.

pcaps.name: Internal SMB WMIExec - failed no privileges (impacket)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated WMIExec attempt using wmiexec.py (impacket) via SMB showing failed access due to insufficient privileges (user authenticated but lacks admin rights on target).

pcaps.name: Internal SMB WMIExec - failed bad password (impacket)
pcaps.description: Internal unauthenticated WMIExec attempt using wmiexec.py (impacket) via SMB showing failed authentication due to incorrect credentials.
